name: Single-Arm Cable Crossover Punch
description: A single-arm cable movement that mimics a cross-body punching motion, pulling the cable from a high or mid pulley position across the body while rotating the torso. This integrates horizontal adduction of the pectoralis major with rotational core engagement, training the chest in a functional, sport-relevant movement plane.

execution.starting_position: Stand side-on to a cable machine set at shoulder height. Grip the handle with the far hand, arm extended to the side toward the cable stack. Stand with a slight staggered stance.
execution.setup_instructions: Set the cable pulley to shoulder or mid-chest height. Attach a single handle. Stand far enough from the stack that the cable is taut at the start position.
steps: Step 1: Grip the handle with the hand farthest from the machine, arm extended toward the stack. Slight bend in the elbow.
Step 2: Drive the handle across your body in a punching motion — extend the arm forward and across the midline while rotating the torso toward the cable.
Step 3: At full extension, the arm crosses the centerline of the body and the torso has rotated to face the direction of the punch.
Step 4: Return with control to the starting position, resisting the cable's pull back. Repeat all reps on one side, then switch.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale forcefully on the punch, inhale on the return.
common_mistakes: Using momentum from the shoulders instead of driving through the chest
Not rotating the torso — the punch should involve the whole core
Standing too close, losing cable tension at the end position
safety_considerations: Keep the shoulder packed — avoid hyperextending the joint at the end of the punch
Control the return — do not let the cable yank the arm back
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension across the body midline. Torso rotates 30–45 degrees through the movement.
coaching_cues: Punch from the chest — the hand follows, not leads
Rotate the torso at the end — your front shoulder should face forward at full extension
